2 902 euros pour une année en cycle de Licence

Bac marocain ou Bac international marocain ou diplôme européen de fin d'études secondaires*, quelque soit votre lieu de résidence et l'année du diplôme, vous devrez formuler vos vœux sur la plateforme Études en France.
Niveau de français requis pour s'inscrire à la formation : B2
Sauf cas de dispense, la certification de français (TCF, DELF B2, DALF) est obligatoire dans le cadre de la procédure de candidature sur la plateforme Études en France.

note.fr: Droits d'inscription différenciés pour les étudiants hors Union européenne : certains établissements exonèrent, renseignez-vous sur leur site.
note.en: Differentiated tuition fees apply to students from outside the EU: some institutions exempt them, check the institution's website.

note.fr: L'admission en 1re année est sélective : les candidatures sont examinées par une commission d'examen des vœux selon la grille publiée (résultats scolaires 25 %, méthodes de travail 25 %, savoir-être 25 %, motivation 20 %, engagement 5 %). Consultez la fiche Parcoursup pour vérifier les modalités applicables aux candidats titulaires d'un bac marocain.
note.en: Admission to year 1 is selective: applications are reviewed by a commission using the published grid (academic results 25%, working methods 25%, behaviour 25%, motivation 20%, engagement 5%). Check the Parcoursup page for the arrangements applicable to holders of a Moroccan Baccalaureat.

notes: Read by code from the Parcoursup fiche (French level, distance learning) and from Campus France national pages (duration, fees for a non-EU student at a public institution, certificate, platform). The national facts are not this programme's own page. | Pages are about the BUT Informatique at IUT d'Aix-Marseille, site d'Arles. durationYears is confirmed by '3 ans – 180 ECTS' on the programme page (also 'former des informaticiens généralistes en 3 ans'). Teaching language: the programme is taught in French; the only explicit language requirements on the pages are a B2 level of French for entry and, on the programme page, English language as LV1 plus TOEIC certification offered ('Certifications proposées : TOEIC, PIX, Voltaire'), so 'en' is not listed as a teaching language. Tuition: no fee for the applicant's profile could be quoted for this programme. The only figures stated are the national registration fee of EUR 178/year ('Droits d'inscription nationaux : 178 €*'), which is the fee for French/EU students and is not stated for non-EU students in the programme pages; the Campus France Maroc page gives EUR 2 902 for a Licence year for extra-community students but that is a general institution-independent statement about public higher-education institutions in France, not this programme, so it was left out. Notably, a LinkedIn post from Aix-Marseille Universite (2019) states non-EU students are exempt from differentiated fees at AMU, but it concerns academic year 2019/2020 and is on a third-party social network, so it was not used as a fact. Intakes: the pages give no application deadline or intake date for this programme for a foreign-diploma applicant (the Parcoursup page mentions only '56 places en 2026' and the ADIUT Maroc calendar 2026 is a PDF that is not reproduced here); no intake fact was produced. Application channel is deliberately omitted per the task.
